from_notes: No Detention Policy: Under the RTE Act, children are not to be held back or detained in the same grade until the completion of the elementary stage (Class 8).
x: The RTE Act prohibits capitation fees and provides for School Management Committees; as enacted it had a no-detention rule till Class 8. It never permitted detention 'from Class 5 onwards' – since the 2019 amendment a child may be held back only in Class 5 or Class 8, and only after failing a re-examination.
dispute: Most books and the source: no detention till Class 8. Strictly: the RTE (Amendment) Act, 2019 lets the appropriate government hold back children in Classes 5 and 8 after a failed re-examination (Centre applied it to its schools, December 2024).
source: AP CA Monthly Apr 2025 p.40; web search Nov 2026 (dtnext.in / theprint.in, Centre scraps no-detention policy for Classes 5 and 8, Dec 2024) – search summary
evidence: web search: RTE Amendment Act 2019 and RTE Rules amendment of 16 Dec 2024
